capabilities: show a diary calendar view with month navigation and a Today button
open or create the note for a clicked date
create diary notes in a <folder>/<year>/<month>/<day> folder hierarchy
insert parent links via the {{diary-link}} template placeholder
replace title, date and time placeholders from a template note
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests and no telemetry, and only reads/writes inside the vault.
intentEvidence: Diary Linker adds a calendar view for your daily notes
problem: Obsidian's daily notes have no calendar to click through dates and no built-in structure linking day notes to month, year and root notes.
summary: Calendar-view plugin for daily notes that opens or creates notes per date and links day, month, year and root notes into a diary hierarchy.
